entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: The red-white guild of Ravnica, the righteous constabulary (League of Wojek) and standing army (Boros Army) enforcing the Azorius Senate's laws.

entities.name: Razia
entities.description: The flaming-sword-wielding archangel who founded the Boros Legion and was its icon until her death.

entities.name: Aurelia
entities.description: The war-leader who became Boros guildmaster, reformed the guild, and led it against Nicol Bolas and the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Feather
entities.description: A disgraced angel who led the Boros as guildmaster during the Interregnum.

entities.name: Tajic
entities.description: Commander of the Boros Theatre of Fortification.

entities.name: League of Wojek
entities.description: The law enforcement half of the Boros Legion that polices the districts of Ravnica City.

entities.name: Boros Army
entities.description: The soldier half of the Boros Legion.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: The body that creates the laws the Boros enforce.

entities.name: Orzhov
entities.description: The guild whose families hired Boros bodyguards during the Interregnum.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: A guild the Boros fight through the Theatre of Order.

entities.name: Dimir
entities.description: A subversive guild whose sleeper agents the Boros root out.

entities.name: Izzet
entities.description: The guild that cooperates with the Boros in the Warmind Initiative.

entities.name: Sunhome
entities.description: The Boros guildhall, a combined fortress, barracks and place of worship.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane and city where the Boros keep order.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The Elder Dragon the Boros fought in the War of the Spark.

entities.name: The Interregnum
entities.description: The period after Razia's death when the Boros worked as hired guards under Feather.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: The battle against Nicol Bolas in which Aurelia and the Boros led the vanguard.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion in which the Boros suffered heavy losses as frontline fighters.

events.summary: The Boros Legion is founded by the archangel Razia.
events.quote: The Boros Legion was founded by parun Razia

events.summary: After Razia's death, the Boros work as hired guards, mostly for Orzhov families, under guildmaster Feather.
events.quote: the Boros mainly worked as paid bodyguards and security officials for the highest bidders, mostly Orzhov families

events.summary: Discontented Boros gather under the war-leader Aurelia, who argues that no disgraced angel should lead them.
events.quote: gathered under the war-leader Aurelia, who argued that no disgraced angel should lead the Boros

events.summary: Aurelia becomes guildmaster and reforms the guild, encouraging angels to mingle with lower ranks.
events.quote: After Aurelia assumed the office of guildmaster, she established several changes to the way the guild was run.

events.summary: Aurelia splits the legion into four theatres to deal with threats to public order.
events.quote: Aurelia has split leadership of the bulk of the legion into four

events.summary: The guild is reorganized into small local garrisons so spies can compromise only one.
events.quote: the reorganization of the guild into countless small local forces

events.summary: Aurelia and the Boros fight in the vanguard against Nicol Bolas in the War of the Spark.
events.quote: Aurelia and the Boros Legion were in the vanguard of the troops fighting Nicol Bolas in the War of the Spark

events.summary: As frontline fighters against the New Phyrexian Invasion the Boros suffer heavy losses and a crisis of faith; Aurelia takes the losses hard.
events.quote: Guildmaster Aurelia took the losses particularly hard.

relations.quote: The Boros Legion was founded by parun Razia
After Aurelia assumed the office of guildmaster

relations.note: The Theatre of Order fights Rakdos incursions.
relations.quote: tasked to fight against Rakdos incursions

relations.note: The Theatre of Integrity roots out Dimir agents.
relations.quote: find the sleeper agents and hidden refuges of the Dimir
The Warmind Initiative is a conjoined effort of the Izzet and the Boros

relations.note: The Legion enforces laws made by the Azorius Senate.
relations.quote: enforces Ravnican laws created by the Azorius Senate
the red-white guild from the plane and city of Ravnica
